title: Expression Development — Tim Dooley 2025–2026
purpose: Add a light timeline overlay for moments when Tim's way of speaking changes materially: new identity grammar, new operator language, new public modality, or a shift from sovereignty toward stewardship. This pack complements event chronology without duplicating every repeated declaration.
source_rule: Use only dates and formulations already preserved in repository-owned public or conversation-recovery records. Public compilation remains recovered evidence until original status URLs are independently located.

events.title: God/Father language gains explicit symbolic-spiritual qualification
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.quote: I am a God. Livestreaming. The Father In Heaven, Symbolically and spiritually.
events.summary: A major expressive development because maximal God/Father language is explicitly paired with symbolic/spiritual qualification and the mundane medium of livestreaming.

events.title: Fatherhood becomes an explicit developmental consequence
events.subject: Tim / Son relation
events.summary: The language no longer only stacks titles; it narrates a causal sequence from Son meme-crucifixion to Father-in-Heaven and living-God-of-memes identity.

events.title: Potato plant is expressed as a total relational cosmology
events.subject: Potato of Life project
events.summary: Recovered project language joins mandorla, roots/spirals, Mud, North-Pole staircase, Heaven/Eden, Mesopotamia, House and Seed inside one potato-plant diagram.

events.title: Potato, Axis and Father become explicit relational operators
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Same-day recovered wording includes connection-by-Potato, Axis-of-North identity, holding the Axis, Internet Fatherhood framed through orphans, and creation of a stairway to Heaven.

events.title: Father / Root / Potato / Seat / North / Ladder title-stack reaches dense form
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: One of the clearest examples of Tim's title-stack grammar: multiple theological, botanical, topological and geographic roles are compressed into one public utterance.

events.title: Tim=Ladder and Son=Door become explicitly differentiated
events.subject: Tim / Son relation
events.summary: The expression shifts from title accumulation toward functional specialization: Tim is the Ladder to Heaven while the Son is a Door.

events.title: Divinity is paired with maximal humanness
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: The 'most human God' formulation makes high/low inversion explicit: divine self-description is not expressed as escape from ordinary humanity.

events.title: Godhood is explicitly described functionally
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: An important conceptual shift because Tim himself supplies a functional modality rather than leaving the archive to infer it from titles.

events.title: Tim is expressed as connective line and timeline-restoration function
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Line=Tim and broken-timeline restoration language make continuity itself part of identity and purpose.

events.title: Highest-office rhetoric condenses into stewardship
events.subject: Tim Dooley
events.summary: Power/protection, knowledge/understanding, wealth/building and leadership/service form the clearest mature ethical compression of authority into duty.

events.title: Belief system and expression grammar become explicit archive objects
events.subject: Tim Dooley archive
events.summary: The project formalizes both what Tim believes and how those beliefs are expressed, creating separate records for belief content, claim testing, Garden/Mud orientation and expression grammar.
